svg.title: After a neuraxial dose: prolonged deceleration with maternal hypotension
svg.desc: Ten-minute synthetic strip at US paper scale. FHR 140 bpm with moderate variability; neuraxial dose at 2 minutes; maternal BP falls from 120/75 to 80/45; FHR falls from 2.5 minutes to about 80 bpm and recovers by 5.5 minutes as BP is restored. External toco shows ordinary contractions at 1, 4 and 8 minutes with relaxation between. Action marker at onset: lateral, fluid, anesthesia-directed pressor.
